create.name: Leslie McGuirk
create.bio:
Leslie McGuirk is an American astrologer, author and artist who has studied astrology for more than three decades. For much of that time it ran alongside a career in illustration and design: she has written and illustrated around twenty picture books for children, including If Rocks Could Sing, and created a line of products sold by the Japanese department store Takashimaya. Only later did she make chart reading the centre of her working life, and since 2000 she has given private readings and workshops for clients in many countries. Her book The Power of Mercury, published by HarperCollins in 2016, uses the planet's position in a chart as a guide to how each person thinks and communicates.

She approaches the birth chart as a pattern to be recognised rather than a forecast, and her teaching leans on metaphor, storytelling, music and humour to make a technical subject easy to grasp. Through her online Astrology Wisdom Academy she offers a beginners' foundation course, recorded classes on each of the planets and a short introduction to numerology. She also hosts the Wayfinder interview series on YouTube, gave a TEDxHollywood talk about creativity and rejection, and leads astrology weekends at Kripalu.

books.title: The Power of Mercury: Understanding Mercury Retrograde and Unlocking the Astrological Secrets of Communication
books.author: Leslie McGuirk
books.description: Leslie's guide to reading Mercury's sign in a birth chart as a key to how a person thinks, talks and learns. It walks through each placement with practical examples and a light touch, and explains what retrograde periods mean in everyday terms.

courses.title: Astrology as a Living Map: Discover Your Inner Design
courses.description: A New Year retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, introducing astrology as a language for seeing the patterns in one's own life. Leslie teaches the basics through story, music and creative props, and prepares each participant's chart in advance; no prior knowledge is needed.

courses.title: Leslie McGuirk's A101 Foundation Course
courses.description: A recorded beginners' course of three classes of about seventy minutes covering the planets, the signs and the houses. Cheat sheets and flash cards support the videos, and the aim is to leave students able to start interpreting charts themselves.

courses.title: The Complete Planet Suite Bundle
courses.description: Ten recorded classes, each between half an hour and an hour, on the Sun, the Moon, every planet from Mercury to Pluto, and Chiron. Each one looks at what that body represents in a chart and how to read it.

courses.title: Numerology Made Simple
courses.description: A one-hour recorded class for beginners on working out a life path number and the theme of the coming year. Leslie presents numerology as a quick extra lens that can be used alongside astrology or on its own.

flags: Her homepage markets one-to-one readings partly on medical and emotional problems ('chronic medical issue', 'mysterious illness, anxiety', recognition by doctors); her natal-readings page carries a no-diagnosis disclaimer. I left the readings out as borderline and wrote nothing medical in the bio; her core work (books, courses, Kripalu) is plain astrology.
Email on the contact page is Cloudflare-obfuscated in the visible text ('send an email to ...') and decoded; the same address appears in the page description.
Academy course URLs are Kajabi offer pages (curl gets 403, likely bot protection); they are the only per-course links on her store page.
Second Instagram account @lesliemcguirk (personal) counted alongside @lesliemcguirkastrology; only the astrology account is linked.
Kripalu's programme page asks participants to send birth data to a separate personal address; that address is not used.
left_out: Natal Chart Readings (https://www.lesliemcguirk.com/natal-readings/): borderline under the health rule because her session marketing names medical issues and anxiety; price not published.
Children's picture books (If Rocks Could Sing, Wiggens Learns His Manners and others): not spiritual teaching.
Individual planet classes ($27 USD each) and the two five-class planet bundles: covered by the Complete Planet Suite.

YouTube: dated or topical videos (election, eclipse, royal family 2024, America at 250, Pope Francis's death, a chart comparison of two people in a criminal case), a COVID-19 interview, 'Astrology To Reduce Suffering' (health framing), interviews where the guest is the main speaker, and clips under 2 minutes.
Podcast episode with Karen Harvey: not YouTube.
